title: Why Does Milk Boil Over So Fast?
description: Why does milk boil over when water does not? The simple science of milk skin and steam bubbles.
comment: Did your milk spill today? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does milk boil over in a flash, but water does not?
Milk has water, but also fat and protein.
As it heats, protein and fat form a thin skin on the surface.
Steam bubbles rise from below, get trapped under that skin, and push the milk up.
So keep the flame low, stir, and use a bigger pot.
